leads_help:
When someone says "go ask so-and-so," it goes on the left.

Find that person and just chat. Say who sent you: they will usually open up. What they tell you is what they know and you don't, which may not be the story you are working on.

A ★ on the map labels and in places marks where a lead is right now.

Leads go cold after three weeks.
